feature.title: Playlists Module and Playlist Tracks in Scenes
feature.problem_statement: Users need to manage playlists and use them alongside scenes, with consistent playback controls and smart shuffle behavior.
feature.user_story: As a user, I can create and manage playlists, play them directly or inside scenes, and always see whether a scene or playlist is currently playing.
global_acceptance_criteria: Users can create, rename, and delete playlists in a new Playlists module tab.
Users can add, remove, and reorder tracks in a playlist; tracks are unique within a playlist and duplicates are disabled in the picker.
Playlists can be played and paused in the Playlists module, with play/pause UI reflecting state.
Playlist shuffle in the Playlists module uses smart random (no repeats until all tracks have played) and is toggleable.
Global now playing shows prefix `Scene: <name>` or `Playlist: <name>` and only one can be playing at a time (scene or playlist).
Scenes can include playlist entries as a track type with per-entry shuffle and repeat toggles independent of the playlist module shuffle.
When a playlist entry in a scene plays, it advances through the playlist tracks sequentially or via smart shuffle; repeat restarts (reshuffle if shuffle is on).
Playlists persist across app restarts in the same way as scenes/tracks.
UI styling matches existing app patterns and aligns with the provided Playlists layout reference.
constraints: Reuse or extend the existing track picker dialog used for scenes, including search, and disable already-included tracks.
Smart shuffle avoids repeats until all tracks in the playlist are played; shuffle order need not persist across app restarts but persists while app is open.
Playlists and scenes are mutually exclusive for global playback; starting one stops the other.
assumptions: Existing persistence mechanism used for scenes/tracks can be extended for playlists.
Existing playback engine can be extended to support playlist sources and playlist entries inside scenes.
Existing UI components for scenes module provide patterns for list, play/pause, and shuffle toggle.
dependencies: Current scenes module UI and track picker dialog implementation
Playback engine / audio player state management

question_log.question: User-visible goal, success criteria, location, out of scope, verification?
question_log.answer: Goal: manage playlists and add them to scenes. Success: create/rename playlists; add/remove/reorder tracks; playlist play with smart shuffle; add playlist to scene; per-playlist-entry shuffle in scene. Location: new module tab. Out of scope: none. Verification: agent-performable without user input.

question_log.question: Track uniqueness behavior?
question_log.answer: Disable already-included tracks in the picker (reuse scene track picker dialog if possible).

question_log.question: Playlist-in-scene behavior and shuffle persistence?
question_log.answer: Playlist entries are their own track type with per-entry shuffle/repeat; smart shuffle avoids repeats until all played; shuffle order persists while app is open but not across restarts.
